en_US.title: Photic Mat Codex Card
en_US.scanner: Photic mat: oxygen-positive, pressure-fragile, edible to grazers, dangerous when torn.
en_US.field_note: Cut samples only from loose edges. If the mat is sealing a crack, it is already doing a job you may need later.
en_US.terminal: SPECIMEN: photic mat. Oxygen-positive, pressure-fragile. Do not harvest large sheets near sealed seams.
en_US.audio: Light here is work, not comfort.
en_US.in_game_wiki: A photic mat is a living oxygen surface, not decoration. It brightens shallow routes, feeds glass grazers, and flags places where mineral film, pressure chemistry, and life are meeting too quickly. Small samples are useful. Tearing a sheet near a sealed seam can release trapped gas, wake grazers, or turn a safe-looking patch into a route hazard.
en_US.external_site: The photic shelf is bright because life is doing work under pressure, not because HECTON-8 is safe.

en_US.title: Glass Grazer Codex Card
en_US.scanner: Glass grazer: non-hostile. If the school freezes, leave the open water.
en_US.field_note: When the school locks still, stop treating the clearing as safe. Something is reading the same water you are.
en_US.terminal: SPECIMEN: glass grazer school. Predator-risk proxy, not harvest target.
en_US.audio: When they stop eating, you stop moving.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Glass grazers are non-hostile, but their movement is useful evidence. Active feeding usually means low immediate predator pressure. A frozen or vanished school means the clearing has changed faster than the scanner can explain.
en_US.external_site: HECTON-8's harmless life is part of the survival interface: movement, absence and damage tell the player what a meter cannot.

en_US.field_note: Follow the glow only after current and residue agree. Pretty light is not a route plan.

en_US.external_site: The shallow ocean's light can guide or mislead; HECTON-8 makes beauty part of navigation, not a postcard.
